name: Magellan Explorer

seo.title: Magellan Explorer: Antarctica21 Air-Cruise Ship
seo.description: Magellan Explorer, Antarctica21's 90.7 m expedition ship built for air-cruises: 88 guests on air-cruises, 96 on sea voyages, seven cabin categories, PC6 ice class, launched 2019.

tagline: The ship Antarctica21 calls the first built for Antarctic air-cruises.
answer: Magellan Explorer is Antarctica21's 90.7 m expedition ship, launched in 2019 and described by the company as the first expedition vessel custom designed for Antarctic air-cruises. She carries up to 88 guests on air-cruises and 96 on sea voyages in seven cabin categories, with 60 staff and crew, and sails the Peninsula, South Georgia, the Falklands and the Chilean fjords.
facts: LR PC6; built to Polar Code specifications
Up to 88 on air-cruises; 96 on sea voyages
2 enclosed lifeboats and 8 life rafts, total capacity 320
8 and over on air-cruises; 12 and over on sea voyages
overview: Magellan Explorer was built in Chile for Antarctica21's fly and sail model: construction began in 2016 and she launched in 2019. She is sized to keep every guest ashore at a landing within Antarctic visitor limits, with up to 88 guests on air-cruises.

Public spaces include a glass enclosed observation lounge with a presentation room, a forward facing observation deck, a library, a gym designed with Anytime Fitness, a dining room with panoramic windows, the Antarctica Lounge bar and a sauna. Every cabin has a sitting area, wardrobe, individual heating and a bathroom with shower and heated floors; all except the Porthole cabins have outdoor seating.
why: Antarctica21 calls her the world's first expedition vessel custom designed for Antarctic air-cruise operations. Her environmental list includes Tier III emissions compliance through selective catalytic reduction, heat recovery, reverse osmosis water, ballast water treatment and fuel optimisation monitoring.

pricesNote: From fares are per person, double cabin, in US dollars, as Antarctica21 shows them. Dated departures and fares by cabin load in Antarctica21's live booking tool and are added here as they are confirmed. Dedicated single cabins carry no single supplement; in shared cabin categories Antarctica21 charges an 85% supplement on some cabins and 100% on the rest.
inclusions: Expedition cruise with guided shore landings, Zodiac excursions, lectures and onboard entertainment
Buffet breakfast and lunch and a la carte dinner, with wine, beer, juice, soft drinks, coffee, tea and snacks
Loan of waterproof boots, contingency plan and IAATO passenger fee
On air-cruises: the flight or flights between Punta Arenas and King George Island, Punta Arenas hotel night or nights at the Cabo de Hornos Hotel or similar, transfers and access to Explorers House
exclusions: International flights to and from the gateway city
Medical insurance with aero medical evacuation cover (required by Antarctica21)
Optional sea kayaking, hiking and snowshoeing (priced separately)
children: Air-cruises: children must be at least 8 years old, at least 1.20 m (3.9 ft) tall and weigh 30 kg or more, travel with a responsible adult who signs a waiver. Children under 12 receive a 5% discount on the per person rate. Sea voyages: minimum age 12, per Antarctica21's travel tips FAQ.
faqs: How many guests does Magellan Explorer carry?
Up to 88 on air-cruises and 96 on sea voyages, with 60 staff and crew.
Does every cabin have a balcony?
No. All categories except the Porthole Cabin have private outdoor seating.
Antarctica21 describes her as the world's first expedition vessel custom designed for Antarctic air-cruise operations, built to Polar Code specifications with LR PC6 ice class.

Classic Antarctica, Polar Circle, Antarctica Express and Antarctica and South Georgia air-cruises, plus the Patagonia and Chilean Fjords, Falklands, Falklands and South Georgia, and Falklands, South Georgia and Antarctica sea voyages.
Can solo travellers avoid a supplement?
Yes, in the Single Veranda Cabin, which carries no supplement.
Is there a doctor on board?
Antarctica21 says its ships have a small infirmary and a licensed doctor. Medical insurance with aero medical evacuation is required.
